name: draft-to-living-cell
title: From Draft to Living Cell
lead: This investigation turns the paper's nine composition patterns into executable, behavior-gated tests of three things you can do with a cellular interface: COMPOSE it, SWAP the mechanism behind it, and watch it EMERGE. Compose is the through-line — every study couples one typed interface to other entities and measures the emergent consequence. The flagship, cell-environment-coupling, reads a spatio-flux nutrient grid at a real CPM cell's own footprint, runs one dynamic-FBA step (e_coli_core, oxygen-capped to force acetate overflow), grows the cell from the biomass, and writes uptake and secretion back into the field: over 20 ticks the cell grows roughly 3.4x (32 to 110 CPM pixels on a 60x60 field), depletes its own footprint glucose by up to ~18% before diffusion resupplies it, and leaves a spreading acetate plume — niche construction, the emergent consequence of composing a cell interface with an environment, not a scripted trajectory. Compose the same kind of interface with neighbours and competition and cross-feeding emerge; with internal reaction and diffusion, a Turing pattern; with a division rule, a lineage. Swap is the paper's equivalence-class claim, measured: the same interface realized by a different mechanism preserves the observable relation — dynamic-FBA versus a lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic behind the byte-identical flagship ports agree within ~10%, and the same swap holds at the multi-cell colony interface too, so substitutability is shown at more than one level of composition (the remaining levels are an honest, named frontier). Emerge is the inward move: a membrane produced and maintained by its own internal process persists, while the identical membrane with that process switched off decays — the boundary made from the inside, not assumed. Read in order the nine studies still trace an arc, from the bare interface contract to a growing, competing, self-maintaining, evolving agent. These are demonstrations with toy-real constants, not fitted models, and every study states its honest gap; process bigraphs and Vivarium are the example substrate, not the thesis.

at_a_glance.role: [EMERGE · the contract] A cell's exposed variables (footprint, fluxes, shape, viability) ARE its interface; the study makes the inside/outside boundary explicit and shows the same contract behind different realizations (lumped modalities, executable handler, and a spatial composition with a diffusion field). The foundation cell-environment-coupling composes from.

[COMPOSE × environment · SWAP · flagship] Compose the cell interface with a real spatio-flux nutrient field (CpmCellField) — senses local glucose, runs dynamic-FBA (e_coli_core, O2-capped to force acetate overflow), grows ~3.4x, secretes a diffusing plume: environmental modification (local depletion + secretion) as an emergent consequence, not a scripted trajectory. Carries a SWAP as surrogate calibration: dynamic-FBA vs a tuned lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic behind byte-identical ports, interface observables within ~10% on the tuned condition (held-out is the named next step).

[COMPOSE × cells · SWAP] Compose the interface with neighbours over a shared field → resource preemption between two cells and metabolic cross-feeding emerge (population-level competitive exclusion, an ecological concept, would need dividing populations — the growth-and-division machinery — not two single non-dividing cells). Carries the second SWAP as surrogate calibration, at the multi-cell colony interface: the colony's per-cell metabolism swapped dynamic-FBA -> a tuned lumped Michaelis-Menten behind byte-identical CpmColonyField ports, observables preserved on the tuned condition — a calibrated match at a second level, with the ~0.2% volume agreement noted as a lattice-saturation artifact and a pre-saturation comparison pending.

[COMPOSE fails] The interface dissolves: composed with a rising toxin field, viability crosses a threshold and the cell ceases to be the appropriate unit of description — molecular processes (resorption, shedding) take its place. Death as a change in the level of description. The foil to autopoiesis (a boundary lost from outside, not maintained from within).

[COMPOSE internal · channels] Reaction composed with differential diffusion → a Turing pattern emerges (causally isolated by an equal-diffusion control going uniform); adding a thermal channel composes a second physical modality that coarsens the pattern. The interface's chemical + thermal ports realized from internal composition.

[EMERGE (formation) · COMPOSE] A phase boundary is PRODUCED from a well-mixed field by internal spinodal decomposition (mass-conserved) — interface formation from the inside; and differential adhesion composes cells into sorted domains. Formation without maintenance — the partial case autopoiesis completes.

[EMERGE · the full case] The membrane is produced AND maintained by its own internal process: it persists with production on, and the identical membrane with production switched off (single-knob control) loses closure and decays to zero. The boundary made and sustained from the inside — the paper's individual criterion, executable.

[COMPOSE × division] Compose the interface with real per-footprint dFBA metabolism and a volume-gated division rule → a lineage emerges: multi-generation growth, bounded sawtooth volume, sibling desynchronization by crowding. The interface reproducing itself.

[COMPOSE across timescales · capstone] A colony develops a rim/core organization (emergent from internal mass balance) and evolves a heritable uptake trait under selection-by-differential- division — mean trait up in 4/5 seeds versus frozen no-mutation and undirected no-selection controls. Composition organizing adaptation across timescales.

how_to_read: Read the nine studies as three moves the paper makes with an interface, not only a linear arc. COMPOSE is the through-line — every study couples the interface to other entities and measures the emergent consequence: cell-environment-coupling (× an environment → niche construction), cell-cell-coupling (× other cells → competition and cross-feeding), molecular-interfaces (internal reaction + diffusion → a Turing pattern), growth-and-division (× a division rule → a lineage), development-and-evolution (across timescales → adaptation), and disintegration (composition failing → the interface dissolves). SWAP — cell-environment-coupling and cell-cell-coupling each carry a surrogate-calibration result (dynamic-FBA versus a TUNED lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic behind byte-identical ports, observables preserved on the tuned condition) at two different levels of composition; a held-out condition neither mechanism was tuned on, and a pre-saturation colony window, are the named frontier before the result is mechanism-independence rather than a fit. EMERGE — cellular-interface makes the contract explicit, biomolecular-complementarity produces a boundary from a well-mixed field, and autopoiesis produces AND maintains one from the inside (with a single-knob control that decays without it). Each study is a behavior-gated test on genuine simulation output, tagged by move in the at-a-glance above, and states in the paper's own vocabulary exactly what it does and does not demonstrate.

glossary.definition: A lattice-based cell-shape simulation framework (here, viva-cpm, a Rust-backed engine) in which cells occupy sets of pixels and evolve their shape, adhesion, and volume by energy-minimizing Monte Carlo pixel copies, rather than being represented as a scalar state bundle.
A process-bigraph-native package providing spatial reaction-diffusion-advection PDE processes (DiffusionAdvection) and spatial dynamic flux-balance analysis (DynamicFBA) over a 2D field grid.

The coupling process the flagship builds: a process-bigraph Process that owns a viva-cpm world object, reads a shared spatio-flux fields grid at the CPM cell's current footprint, runs one dynamic-FBA step there, grows the CPM cell's target volume from the resulting biomass, and writes the uptake/secretion back into the field as a spatial delta. The typed interface the paper's composition claim is made concrete through.

The small set of variables across a cell's boundary that carry the interactions that matter — at once a modeling choice (what to expose, what to abstract) and a testable hypothesis (each study passes or fails a behavior gate on its chosen interface). The subject of this investigation; process bigraphs are the substrate used to express it.

The paper's equivalence-class claim: different mechanisms may realize the same externally observable relation, so an interface is a natural level at which heterogeneous mechanisms can be compared. Approached here as SURROGATE CALIBRATION, not yet demonstrated substitutability: at two levels of composition — the flagship's metabolism (dynamic-FBA vs a TUNED lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic, four free parameters, behind byte-identical CpmCellField ports) and the cell-cell colony (the same tuned swap behind byte-identical CpmColonyField ports) — the interface observables agree within ~10% on the condition the surrogate was tuned on. Four knobs matching roughly four observables demonstrates that a surrogate CAN be fit, not that the mechanisms are interchangeable; the claim is earned only when the agreement holds on a HELD-OUT condition neither mechanism was tuned on (and, for the colony, before lattice saturation). That held-out test is the named frontier, together with broadening the swap to the other levels.

The three things the paper does with an interface, and the spine of this investigation. COMPOSE it with other entities — outward to an environment and neighbours, inward to a metabolism and a membrane — and an emergent consequence appears. SWAP the mechanism behind it and the observable relation is preserved. EMERGE: the interface itself is produced and maintained by internal composition, not given. Every study is a behavior-gated test of one of these moves.

Outward composition couples a cell to its environment and to other cells; inward composition is internal processes composing to produce the interface and its viability constraints. Every study is labeled by direction and by the move (compose / swap / emerge) it demonstrates.

Plausible, hand-tuned constants (e.g. glucose_km, glucose_vmax, oxygen_vmax, box_volume_L, grow_per_biomass) chosen to produce legible, gradual dynamics over a short run — not fitted to a named organism, medium, or literature target.

biological_story:
A cell in a real 2D environment is not a point that reads and writes scalars — it is a shape, occupying a footprint of lattice pixels that grows, moves, and metabolizes at whatever concentration happens to sit under it right now. The paper's thesis is that we can reason about such a cell by naming its interface: the small set of variables across its boundary that carry the interactions that matter. This investigation makes that thesis executable, one pattern at a time, and lets the studies build on each other into an arc — from the bare interface contract, through a cell that senses and acts on its environment, competes with neighbors, and dissolves when its viability fails, to one that maintains itself, grows, divides, and evolves.

The flagship study, cell-environment-coupling, answers yes for the outward sense/act pattern. One coupling process, CpmCellField, is the entire interface: it reads the spatio-flux glucose field at the CPM cell's current footprint, solves one dynamic-FBA step against e_coli_core (oxygen-capped so the optimizer is pushed into mixed-acid acetate overflow, the way a real glycolysis-outpacing- respiration cell would be), grows the CPM cell's target volume from the biomass that solution produces, and writes the resulting uptake and secretion back into the shared field as a spatial delta that spatio-flux's own diffusion process then spreads outward. Over a 20-tick run the cell grows about 3.4-fold in CPM pixel volume, draws its own local glucose down by close to a fifth before diffusion partially refills it, and leaves a spreading acetate plume behind it — niche construction as a direct, unscripted consequence of two independently-built simulators talking through one typed port.

The other eight patterns fill out the arc: the cellular-interface contract itself; multi-cell competition over a shared field; a structural-integrity collapse in which the cell ceases to be the appropriate unit of description and molecular processes take its place; molecular-scale reaction-diffusion with a thermal channel; differential-adhesion sorting and phase separation for complementarity; a self-maintained protocell whose viability bound is produced from the inside; CPM growth and division; and colony development-and-evolution under selection. Learning — a cell whose past changes its future regulation to stay viable — is named as the next rung and not yet built. Every study is toy-real and honest about its gap; together they are an executable path from a draft interface to a living, adapting cell.
question: The paper treats a biological interface as a scientific object — something you can compose with other entities, swap the mechanism behind, and watch emerge from the inside. Does that hold in executable form? Across nine composition patterns this investigation asks three things about the interface. COMPOSE — when one typed interface is coupled to other entities, outward to a nutrient field and to neighbouring cells and inward to a metabolism and a membrane, does the composition produce the emergent consequence the paper predicts (niche construction, competition, cross-feeding, pattern, division), on genuine simulation output rather than a scripted trajectory? SWAP — is the same interface substitutable, so the externally observable relation survives when the mechanism behind it is replaced (dynamic-FBA by a lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic) — and does that hold at more than one level of composition, not just inside a single cell? EMERGE — can a cell's boundary itself be an emergent product of its own internal processes, produced and maintained from the inside rather than merely given? The subject is the interface; process bigraphs (Vivarium) are the example substrate we use to make it executable.
hypothesis: An interface is a property of a composition, not of any single mechanism behind it, and the three moves the paper makes with it are all executable. COMPOSE: coupling one typed interface to other entities — outward to an environment and neighbours, inward to a metabolism and a membrane — yields emergent behaviour the interface alone does not have, and every study measures such a consequence on genuine simulation output. SWAP: where the same interface is realized by two different mechanisms the observable relation is preserved — approached as surrogate calibration (a tuned Michaelis-Menten twin agrees within ~10% on the condition it was tuned on) at two levels, the single-cell metabolism and the multi-cell colony, with held-out generalization and the remaining levels an explicit, honestly-flagged frontier. EMERGE: a cell's boundary can be produced and sustained by internal composition — a membrane that runs its own maintenance persists, while the identical membrane without that process decays — the interface made, not assumed. Each study is a behavior-gated test of one of these claims.

executive.what_is_this:
"From Draft to Living Cell" is the executable companion to the meta-modeler's guide: the paper's nine cellular composition patterns, each realized as a runnable model behind one typed interface. The organizing idea is the paper's own — an interface is a modeling choice and a testable biological hypothesis at once, naming which interactions across a cell's boundary matter and which can be abstracted away. Every study makes one such interface explicit and puts it behind a behavior gate. The interface is the load-bearing artifact: it, not either framework alone, is what lets two simulators that were never designed with each other in mind compose. The flagship's coupling process, CpmCellField, is exactly this — the point where a CPM cell's footprint (a set of lattice pixels) becomes a spatio-flux field read, and a dynamic-FBA solution (mmol/gDW/hr fluxes) becomes a per-pixel field delta and a CPM target-volume update. Composition runs in two directions: outward, where a cell couples to its environment and to other cells; and inward, where internal processes compose to produce the interface and the viability constraints that hold it together. Process bigraphs and Vivarium are the example substrate that makes all of this executable — they are how the patterns are expressed, not the claim being tested.

The paper makes three moves with such an interface, and each is executable here. COMPOSE it with other entities — outward to an environment and neighbours, inward to a metabolism and a membrane — and an emergent consequence appears that the interface alone does not have; every study measures one. SWAP the mechanism behind it and the observable relation is preserved — shown as a measured result at two levels of composition: the flagship swaps its internal metabolism from dynamic-FBA to a TUNED lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic (four free parameters) behind byte-identical CpmCellField ports (observables within ~10% on the tuned condition), and the cell-cell colony swaps the same mechanism behind byte-identical CpmColonyField ports with the observables preserved. This is surrogate calibration — a fit, honest as such — and a held-out condition neither mechanism was tuned on, plus broadening the swap to the remaining levels, is the named frontier, not a silent gap. EMERGE — the interface is not only composed and swapped but made: in autopoiesis a membrane is produced and maintained by its own internal process, decaying the moment that process is switched off. Same interface, different mechanism, at more than one level; and a boundary that makes itself.

A framing note stated up front, not buried in the verdict. The title "From Draft to Living Cell" and the arc language (a growing, competing, self-maintaining, evolving agent) are a narrative reading of the nine studies, not a claim of a validated cell — the verdict is explicitly "not a quantitatively validated cell." The SWAP result is a tuned surrogate matching on its calibration condition (surrogate calibration), not yet held-out mechanism-independence; the EMERGE result is an authored operational-closure criterion whose consequences are tested, not closure emerging from local physics; and every acceptance gate below is, unless marked otherwise, a regression pin set after its run — the honest, narrower claim is that the paper's nine patterns can each be expressed, run, and consequence-tested as compositions of independently-built simulators behind typed interfaces, with single-variable controls.
executive.verdict: The pattern set is complete and the central claim holds in executable form. All nine of the paper's composition patterns have a study; eight are realized as real 2D spatial compositions (a Cellular Potts cell coupled through one typed process to spatio-flux diffusion and dynamic-FBA, or to a pure reaction-diffusion or phase-field mechanism), and the ninth is the foundational cellular-interface contract itself. The flagship, cell-environment-coupling, closes the outward sense/act loop with genuine simulation output — over 20 ticks the agent depletes local glucose (up to ~18% at its own footprint before diffusion partially resupplies it), grows (CPM volume 32 -> 110 pixels, roughly 3.4x, against a 3600-pixel lattice it does not come close to filling), and secretes acetate that diffuses outward into a plume. This is niche construction as a real spatial and metabolic consequence of coupling two independently-built simulators, not a scripted trajectory. Substitutability is shown as surrogate calibration, not yet as a held-out finding: a tuned Michaelis-Menten twin (four free parameters) reproduces the interface observables within ~10% on the condition it was tuned on, behind the same byte-identical ports — calibrated agreement, with a held-out condition neither mechanism saw the named next step before the word "substitutable" is earned. These are demonstrations with toy-real constants, not calibrated models, and each study names its own honest gap — the whole is a proof that the paper's interfaces compose and behave as claimed, not a quantitatively validated cell.
decisions_needed: All nine composition patterns now have a study: eight realized as real 2D spatial mechanisms (cell-environment-coupling, cell-cell-coupling, disintegration, molecular-interfaces, biomolecular-complementarity, autopoiesis, growth-and-division, development-and-evolution) plus the foundational cellular-interface contract. The honest frontier is not coverage but depth: each study realizes part of its pattern's full claim and names the rest as a gap.

The arc's open next rung is learning — a cell whose history of interaction changes its future regulation in a way that measurably improves its capacity to stay viable, the executable bridge from a self-maintaining agent to an adaptive one. It is named here but not yet built.

Two of the paper's four physical interface modalities remain unrealized across the whole investigation: mechanical forces and electrical currents. The chemical port is everywhere and the thermal port appears in molecular-interfaces; a mechanical/tension channel and an electrostatic channel are the standing gap.

scientific_argument.main_claim: A biological interface is a scientific object defined by three things you can do with it, and all three are executable here. COMPOSE — coupling the interface to other entities (outward to an environment and neighbours, inward to a metabolism and a membrane) produces emergent behaviour the interface alone does not have, measured on genuine simulation output in every study. SWAP — a tuned surrogate mechanism reproduces the externally observable relation behind byte-identical ports, calibrated at two levels of composition (the single-cell metabolism and the multi-cell colony); this is surrogate calibration, and mechanism-independence proper is earned only on a held-out condition, the named next step. EMERGE — the interface itself is produced and maintained by internal composition; here that maintenance is an authored operational-closure criterion whose consequences are tested, not closure emerging from local physics. The interface — not either framework alone — is the load-bearing artifact that makes each of these possible.
evidence_for: cell-environment-coupling (the outward sense/act flagship) — a real CPM cell reads a spatio-flux glucose field at its own footprint, runs one dynamic-FBA step (e_coli_core, oxygen-capped to force acetate overflow), grows its CPM target volume from the biomass produced, and writes uptake/secretion back into the field as a spatial delta that DiffusionAdvection then spreads. Over 20 ticks: CPM volume grows ~3.4x (32 -> 110 px, ~3% of the 60x60 lattice — the cell does not fill it), local footprint glucose depletes up to ~18% before diffusion partially resupplies it, and the field-wide acetate total rises from 0 to ~47 field units as the secreted plume diffuses outward. Net field-wide glucose falls (~32 of 5940 total field mass consumed) even though the depletion signal is much sharper locally at the cell's own footprint than in the field-wide total — the direct environmental-modification signature (local depletion + secretion; "niche construction" is reserved for development-and-evolution, where a selection feedback closes the loop).

Surrogate calibration of the interface, run concretely at two levels of composition (the SWAP move) — a tuned match, not yet a held-out finding. At the single cell: the flagship's internal metabolism is swapped from dynamic-FBA to a lumped Michaelis-Menten kinetic (four free parameters — vmax, km, yield, overflow — tuned to match, not derived) behind the byte-identical CpmCellField ports, and the interface-level observables (growth, local depletion, secretion) agree within ~10% on the tuned condition. Four knobs fit to roughly four observables is optimizer success; genuine mechanism-independence requires agreement on a condition neither mechanism was tuned on (a different field, O2 cap, or run length) — the named next step. At the multi-cell colony: the same swap behind the byte-identical CpmColonyField ports preserves the colony observables (total biomass 302.4 vs 287.6, competition ratio 3.69x vs 3.47x); the ~0.2% total-volume agreement, however, is measured at ~97.5% lattice occupancy, a finite-lattice saturation ceiling both mechanisms hit, so that number is guaranteed by the artifact, not the interface — a pre-saturation comparison is the pending fix. The Michaelis-Menten arm does run with cobra absent entirely. Same ports, different mechanism, calibrated agreement at two levels; held-out generalization and a pre-saturation colony window are the named frontier, not a silent gap.
evidence_against: Each study realizes only part of its pattern's full claim: two of the four physical modalities (mechanical, electrical) are unrealized investigation-wide; the composition is framework-level, not per-cell; and learning, the arc's next rung, is not yet built.
Chemotaxis (directed up-gradient motion) is deferred; the flagship agent senses and acts on the field locally but does not move toward higher concentration.

The e_coli_core constants (glucose_km, glucose_vmax, oxygen_vmax, box_volume_L, grow_per_biomass) are toy-real — plausible, hand-tuned magnitudes chosen to produce gradual, spatially-legible dynamics over a short run, not fitted to any organism or medium.

The CPM lattice itself (the cell's shape, occupied pixels, footprint) lives inside viva-cpm's Rust engine as a private, write-protected world object, not a process-bigraph store — only the coupling process reads and writes it. The environment the interface exposes to the rest of the composite is exclusively the spatio-flux fields store (glucose, acetate).
caveats: All nine composition patterns have a study, but the investigation demonstrates the patterns, not a calibrated cell: every mechanism is toy-real (plausible constants, not calibrated to a named organism, medium, or literature target), and each study names its own honest gap.

The whole reads as an arc — interface, individuality, viability, self-maintenance, agency, adaptation — with learning as the open next rung. Read the studies in that order for the through-line rather than as nine independent demonstrations.

findings.statement: The same `CellularInterfaceHandler` contract, unchanged, composed with a spatial diffusion field via a field↔point adapter — evidence the interface is substrate-independent. Only the chemical modality is spatialized here; mechanical, electrical, and thermal remain lumped. Taking the byte-identical fig04b handler and composing a spatio-flux `DiffusionAdvection` chemical field behind its chemical port (through the small `FieldPointCoupling` adapter that samples the field over the cell's footprint and writes the handler's uptake flux back as a spatial delta) yields a running 2D composite: the field depletes at the footprint (environmental modification — local resource depletion, footprint mean 1.68 → 1.43 over 20 steps) and the concentration the interface senses now varies with position on the gradient — a cell on the low side senses ≈0.74 and grows slower, one on the high side senses ≈2.1 and grows faster — rather than a fixed constant.

findings.statement: A tuned second handler behind byte-identical cell ports reproduces the interface observables across the chemical operating range — surrogate calibration, not yet mechanism-independence. Two handlers behind byte-identical cell ports — the Monod twin (first-order uptake + independent Monod growth + Arrhenius thermal death) vs a genuinely different box (a saturable Michaelis-Menten membrane-carrier uptake + an independent cooperative Moser/Hill (n=1.3) growth law + Q10 thermal death) — produce interface observables that agree within ~10.5% when chemical supply is SWEPT across chem∈[0.2,2.5]. Measured max relative divergence over the sweep: chemical flux 8.6% (saturable carrier vs first-order line), growth_rate 10.5% (cooperative sigmoid vs Monod hyperbola); driven over a ramp through the whole range the integrated observables diverge at most shape 7.7%, objective 10.5%, viability 0.01% — all under a 15% band across the operating range. This is surrogate calibration — the second handler's ~4 free parameters (vmax, km, cooperative-growth params, Q10) are tuned to reproduce the same ~4 interface observables (4 knobs fit to ~4 constraints), not yet mechanism-independence. The sweep across chem∈[0.2,2.5] is stronger evidence than a single tuned point, but a held-out condition neither handler was fit on — tune the twin on a sub-range, then test on a disjoint held-out sub-range — is the named next step. Complements the metabolism-level swap (dFBA vs Michaelis-Menten) and the colony-level swap.

figure) hold as real spatial multicellularity — multiple CPM cells sharing one diffusing
nutrient field, each running its own dynamic-FBA step at its own footprint, producing both
resource preemption between two cells and cross-feeding — when the whole colony is composed from independent

Confirmed: biomass ratio 2.9-3.7x across 5 seeds (3.69x on the flagship seed; 237.9 vs 64.5), CPM volume 3511 vs 81 px, over a 20-tick run. (This is resource preemption between two single, never-dividing cells, not population-level competitive exclusion, which would need dividing populations -- the loser is displaced but stays viable; see F-04.)

findings.statement: The competition regime reaches asymmetric growth via resource preemption between two single, never-dividing cells, NOT population-level competitive exclusion (which would need dividing populations), over the run measured. This study couples STATE (one shared field) but imposes no viability CONSTRAINT (no death, no viability bound), exactly the paper's §Cell–cell coupling distinction that "what is coupled is not only state, but constraint" -- here, only state. The winner's 3511-px endpoint is ~97.5% of the 3600-px lattice with the field nearly exhausted by t=20, so the endpoint is partly a finite-size lattice-saturation artifact; by t≈30 the winner fills the lattice and the still-viable loser is crowded off it (eviction, not starvation).

studies.name: molecular-interfaces
studies.title: Molecular Interfaces
studies.question: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) frames a molecule not as a lump of state but as a typed interface exposing several physical channels -- chemical, electrostatic, mechanical, thermal -- through which molecules bind, react, and transmit force and heat. It even names the public databases (PDB, Reactome, ChEBI, GO) as "partial specifications of molecular interfaces and their types". This study asks the discriminating question one channel down: does that molecular interface hold SPATIALLY? Concretely -- do local molecular reactions plus differential diffusion (the CHEMICAL channel spatialized as finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion patterning -- not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto) turn a near-uniform seed into emergent spatial structure, and does a static uniform temperature field acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) GRADE that structure -- so that a temperature PARAMETER demonstrably modulates the spatialized chemical channel over one shared spatial field? The causal control -- equal diffusion (Du = Dv), chemistry untouched -- differs in exactly one variable and isolates the diffusion asymmetry as the cause of structure (a regime-specific conclusion for this Gray-Scott system), so the contrast between pattern and uniformity is the finding.

findings.statement: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) CHEMICAL channel holds spatially: a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du) turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott spot pattern (not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto) -- v_var rises ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119 and the field resolves into ~12 connected domains (patterned == 1.0). Local molecular reactions plus differential diffusion produce emergent spatial structure, the molecular interface's chemical channel made spatial.

evidence.observed: patterned == 1.0; v_var ~0.0011 -> ~0.0119; n_domains ~= 12 (multi-seed band [8, 12])

findings.statement: The pattern is CAUSED by the differential-diffusion asymmetry, shown by a single-variable causal control. The equal-diffusion control (Du = Dv = 0.12 -- identical chemistry, seed, and wiring, the only difference the removal of the differential-diffusion asymmetry) stays UNIFORM: v_var ~= 0 (exactly 0.0), patterned == 0.0. Removing only the diffusion asymmetry removes the structure, isolating differential diffusion -- not the chemistry alone -- as its cause. This "differential diffusion is the cause" conclusion is regime-specific for this Gray-Scott system.

evidence.observed: control (Du=Dv=0.12): patterned == 0.0, v_var ~= 0 (exactly 0.0 to 1e-6)

findings.statement: A temperature PARAMETER modulates the chemical channel over the same field: a static uniform temperature field (Ea=0.15, Tref=1.0, T=1.2) acting as an Arrhenius rate multiplier on the reaction (no heat transport, no reaction->heat feedback) GRADES the pattern rather than destroying it -- coarsening it from ~12 domains to ~2 and lowering v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096 while staying comfortably patterned (patterned == 1.0). This is a temperature parameter modulating one physical channel, NOT two physically-transported channels composing. (A hotter Ea=1.0/T=1.5 setting overshoots into near-uniform collapse and was retuned; the overshoot is pinned as a direct-physics assertion, so "graded, not collapsed" is tested against its own failure mode.) The chemical channel is spatialized and a temperature parameter demonstrably modulates it.

evidence.observed: thermal patterned == 1.0; n_domains ~12 -> ~2; v_var ~0.0119 -> ~0.0096 (graded, not collapsed)

findings.statement: DETERMINISM. The Gray-Scott physics has NO RNG -- the GrayScott seed config key is accepted but currently inert -- so the multi-seed check re-draws the INITIAL near-uniform field with seed_uv(seed=s) for s in 1-5 (everything else fixed) rather than varying a per-tick stochastic process. The pattern forms for every seed; v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193] and n_domains in [8, 12] are reported as a RANGE reflecting genuine sensitivity of the emergent pattern to nucleation-patch placement, not dressed as a single golden value.

evidence.observed: v_var in [0.01157, 0.01193], n_domains in [8, 12] across seeds 1-5 (seed lives in the initial field)

studies.claim: The paper's §Molecular interface (Fig 7) holds spatially for its CHEMICAL channel, and a temperature parameter modulates it. The CHEMICAL channel, realized as a Gray-Scott reaction-diffusion system (local autocatalysis U + 2V -> 3V plus differential diffusion Dv < Du), turns a near-uniform seed into an emergent finite-amplitude, nucleation-driven Gray-Scott spot pattern (not linear-instability Turing sensu stricto): v_var rises from ~0.0011 to ~0.0119 with ~12 connected domains (patterned == 1.0). studies.name: autopoiesis

studies.question: The paper's §Self-organized processes section states the autopoiesis criterion as a boundary problem, not a bookkeeping one: "A membrane alone is insufficient: a vesicle may form a boundary without constituting a living system. This study puts that criterion on a 2D lattice and asks the discriminating question directly: does a membrane PERSIST because an internal production loop -- gated on the boundary itself staying topologically closed -- replenishes the membrane against decay, and does a mere vesicle with no such loop, from the identical seed, DISSIPATE? The two composites differ in exactly one variable (the production rate constant k_prod), so the contrast between persistence and collapse is the finding. beer2023's viability bounds -- constraints on a shared state that must be maintained for the composition to persist -- are the frame: closure here is that the membrane's own maintenance is conditioned on the boundary it maintains, so break the boundary and the maintenance cannot fire.

studies.name: growth-and-division

studies.question:
A cell grows, crosses a threshold, and divides -- and its daughters do not necessarily divide together. studies.question: The paper's §Development and evolution section (Fig 10c-f) extends the interface idea across time: individual cellular interfaces become embedded in a COLLECTIVE interface defined by shared state -- a growing colony develops physiological heterogeneity (a depleted core against a fed rim) where each cell's own interface sits inside one collective interface -- and a heritable trait EVOLVES when variation is selected on that shared field. The design is a DUAL control: against the selection-ON colony, a no-mutation arm (the trait cannot vary) and a no-selection arm (the trait mutates but confers no fitness) test whether selection, not mutation or drift, drives it. This study REUSES study 8's dividing colony (`growth-and-division`, `CpmGrowthDivision`) unchanged and adds ONLY one heritable coupling parameter -- the paper's claim that the interfaces and couplings are themselves evolvable features of organization, made concrete by making one coupling parameter heritable and selectable on the colony that already grows and divides.

EVOLUTION -- mean_vmax shifts up in 4/5 seeds under selection while the no-mutation control stays exactly at the founder (0/5) and the no-selection control drifts undirected (2/5, mean ~0), a pattern CONSISTENT WITH selection driving the directional shift via differential division; the n=5 sample is under-powered (4/5 vs 2/5 is not significant), the committed gate evaluates the flagship seed 3, and a >=20-seed drift-null with a rank test is the named next step. The single-seed development reading, the same-knob/crowding bound, and the toy evo-devo scope (facilitated variation deferred) are reported as limitations, not claimed away.

explanatory_gain.basis: Putting the paper's §Development and evolution section on the real dividing colony turns two of biology's hardest transitions into runnable, controlled spatial mechanisms -- development as a measured collective interface, evolution as a heritable coupling parameter selected by differential division -- supplying exactly the phenomenon (real heritable variation, real fitness-based selection) a coarser, non-spatial lumped realization conceded it could only gesture at, by REUSING study 8's colony and adding one heritable coupling parameter.

derived.insight: DEVELOPMENT holds spatially: a growing CPM colony on a shared depleting glucose field forms EMERGENT core-vs-rim physiological heterogeneity -- the radial rim-core glucose ratio (`rim_core_ratio`) grows from 1.0 (few cells, no readable gradient) to ~1.44 over a 45-tick run, the core measurably more depleted than the rim. This is a SINGLE-SEED reading (the flagship seed 3); a 5-seed band with per-cell scatter is the named next step (Tier C), so the ~1.44 magnitude is illustrative, not an ensemble result. Each cell's individual glucose interface becomes embedded in a COLLECTIVE interface defined by the shared field (the paper's §Development and evolution section, Fig 10c-d). Nothing imposes the structure -- it is the same shared-field mass-balance that drove study 8's division desync, read radially (stewart2008/flemming2016 biofilm physiological heterogeneity).
